intro: Give Gerard a Drink is a straightforward favor for Gerard Tiller, a farmer toiling at the Maclure Vineyards in Elwynn Forest. Looking to quench his thirst under the sun, he trades basic produce in exchange for bottles of fresh spring water. It offers young adventurers an early lesson in barter and supporting local laborers.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Farming is thirsty work, and I'm always looking for refreshing spring water.
If you have any, then I'm willing to make a trade.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thanks, friend! And come back if you want to trade again.
